name: Open Energy Data Layer — Philippine Electricity Rates Data API
description: Machine-readable catalog of the static energy-data API: endpoints, files and checksums, source data files and disclaimers. Consumed by the page builder and by anyone who wants to discover the API without parsing the OpenAPI document.
attribution: Source: Department of Energy (DOE) — Electricity Rates & Power Market Monitor, retrieved 2026-11-10T17:00:34+08:00. When republishing, credit DOE as the source and the Open Energy Data Layer for the compilation. Service-area coverage (derived data, not a DOE rate publication): OpenStreetMap Wiki operator table — CC BY-SA 2.0; Wikipedia distribution-utility list — CC BY-SA 4.0; Republic Act No. 12146 (Meralco franchise) — Public document (Philippine law); DOE workbook region column — Not stated by publisher.
citation: Open Energy Data Layer (2026). Open Energy Data Layer: Philippine electricity rates [Data set, v1.0]. Source: Department of Energy (DOE), Electricity Rates & Power Market Monitor, retrieved 2026-11-10. Service-area coverage: OpenStreetMap Wiki operator table — CC BY-SA 2.0; Wikipedia distribution-utility list — CC BY-SA 4.0; Republic Act No. 12146 (Meralco franchise) — Public document (Philippine law); DOE workbook region column — Not stated by publisher. No upstream licence is asserted for the DOE rate data; normalise and verify against the DOE workbook before citing.

disclaimers.title: Unofficial compilation.
disclaimers.text: This is an independent compilation of a public DOE workbook, not an official DOE publication. Verify every figure against the source before citing or acting on it.

disclaimers.title: Upstream reuse terms unconfirmed.
disclaimers.text: The DOE workbook publishes no explicit reuse licence; terms are to be confirmed with DOE. No licence is asserted over the upstream data by this API.

disclaimers.title: NDA, missing and invalid are preserved, never imputed.
disclaimers.text: NDA is the source's "No Data Available"; missing is a month not yet published; invalid is a cell that failed validation. null never means zero and is never an estimate.

disclaimers.title: Rates are monthly averages as published.
disclaimers.text: Actual bills vary by consumption, charges, subsidies and timing. Figures are informational only and not financial advice.

disclaimers.title: Coverage is derived data, not a DOE rate publication.
disclaimers.text: Service-area coverage is derived from franchise law (RA 12146 for MERALCO), the DOE workbook region column as a fallback, and, where present, the OpenStreetMap Wiki operator table (CC BY-SA 2.0) and the Wikipedia distribution-utility list (CC BY-SA 4.0). Because the layer combines CC BY-SA rows, the combined coverage layer is a CC BY-SA derivative: attribution is required and share-alike applies to redistributed coverage data. A franchise area is not verified household-level billing territory; region-level rows are a fallback, not LGU-level confirmation. Keep each source's attribution and licence.

licence.note: The DOE workbook states no explicit reuse licence; terms are to be confirmed with DOE. Used only as a region-level fallback for coverage.

endpoints.summary: Snapshot health: build identity and data-quality check results
endpoints.description: Build identity plus the result of the 17 recorded data-quality checks. "ok" means the snapshot is internally consistent, not that a live service is up.

endpoints.summary: Dataset metadata: source, licence, coverage, status vocabulary, checksums
endpoints.description: One document with the full dataset metadata: coverage, units, identifier schemes, the status vocabulary, the source record, licence status, disclaimers, SHA-256 checksums of the four seed CSVs and links to every machine-readable artefact.

endpoints.summary: Month coverage 2018-01 to 2026-11 with per-class state counts
endpoints.description: The 107 source month columns, the latest published month (2026-10), and for every customer class the count of published / NDA / missing / invalid cells in each month.

endpoints.summary: Source disagreements, with the resolution rule and unresolved splits
endpoints.description: Rows where the workbook's four tabs disagree: region, island-group and grid-connection conflicts, plus name variants. Resolved by majority; a 2-2 grid split is published as CONFLICT rather than guessed.

endpoints.summary: The 17 data-quality checks run against the retrieved workbook
endpoints.description: Row counts, month coverage, spot values, derived aggregates and checksum checks, as run at retrieval time. Published verbatim; any failure would set health status to degraded.

endpoints.summary: Index of the latest published month per customer class
endpoints.description: Points at the four per-class files for 2026-10 with their stats, sizes and checksums. Start here for a single class; use utilities/<CODE>.json for one utility's history.

endpoints.summary: Latest published commercial rate per utility (2026-10)
endpoints.description: The 2026-10 commercial cell for all 141 utilities, with explicit non-published states, the previous month's value and the month-over-month change where both cells are published.

endpoints.summary: Latest published generation rate per utility (2026-10)
endpoints.description: The 2026-10 generation cell for all 141 utilities, with explicit non-published states, the previous month's value and the month-over-month change where both cells are published.

endpoints.summary: Latest published industrial rate per utility (2026-10)
endpoints.description: The 2026-10 industrial cell for all 141 utilities, with explicit non-published states, the previous month's value and the month-over-month change where both cells are published.

endpoints.summary: Latest published residential rate per utility (2026-10)
endpoints.description: The 2026-10 residential cell for all 141 utilities, with explicit non-published states, the previous month's value and the month-over-month change where both cells are published.
Identity, type, grid connection, PSGC region, data status and latest/previous month values for all 141 utilities. Codes discovered here resolve to utilities/<CODE>.json.

endpoints.summary: One utility with its full monthly series per customer class
endpoints.description: Registry record plus all four customer-class series, grouped by explicit source state (published / nda / missing / invalid) for 2018-01 to 2026-11.

endpoints.summary: Provider service-area coverage registry with source provenance
endpoints.description: One item per utility with a compact coverage summary, plus the coverage-source registry (franchise law, DOE fallback, OSM Wiki / Wikipedia tables) and the aggregate counts. This is derived data, not a DOE rate publication.

endpoints.summary: One utility's full service-area coverage rows
endpoints.description: The published coverage rows for one utility (LGU / barangay / region-fallback rows) with the PSGC hierarchy, a per-row source_id and the source records. One file per utility (api/v1/service-areas/<CODE>.json).
Latest-month medians, means and ranges per customer class, reporting counts, island group and the DOE workbook's region label for all 18 regions.

endpoints.summary: One region plus its member utilities
endpoints.description: One region's aggregates plus every member utility with its latest-month values and states.
Month-over-month movements for utility/class pairs published in both months (largest absolute change first), plus cells whose explicit state changed between the two months.

endpoints.summary: Source registry: the DOE workbook and its checksums
endpoints.description: The single upstream source record: canonical DOE URL, workbook URL and sheet id, retrieval timestamp and extraction method, per-tab SHA-256 and byte counts, archived raw snapshots, licence status and provenance notes.
The full source record for one source_id (currently SRC-DOE-RATES). Unknown ids are not served by this static snapshot. One file per source (api/v1/sources/<source_id>.json).
